question: Why did the EG process corrode the aluminium foil, and how was the corrosion product removed?
expect: False premise: the EG process did not corrode the foil (shiny foils, XRD shows only Al, no transition metals by EDX; p3.L114-124); water is the solvent that corrodes Al
rendered: The EG process corroded the aluminum foil due to lithium leaching from the NMC cathode, making the water solution basic. This caused the corrosion of aluminum, forming Al(OH)3 precipitates on the cathode surfaces.

source.file: ChemSusChem - 2020 - Bai - Sustainable Direct Recycling of Lithium‐Ion Batteries via Solvent Recovery of Electrode.pdf
